grid.title: Floating sphere: how deep a sphere of {mat} sinks, {method}
grid.unknown: the depth d to which the sphere sinks

mat.label: ice

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, density of solids

mat.note: Ice at 0 °C has a density of 0.917 g/cm3, so an ice ball floats with about 92 % of its volume under water.

mat.label: cork

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, density of solids

mat.note: Cork has a density near 0.24 g/cm3, so the sphere rides high and the cubic has its root well below R.
